item.title: Maharashtra Government Denies Delay In Seeking Flood Aid
item.description: Nationalist Congress Party (Sharad Pawar) MP Supriya Sule had alleged that despite severe distress caused by months of heavy rainfall and crop damage, the state government had not submitted a proposal for central assistance.

item.title: Ajit Pawar Opposes Maharashtra government’s Plan To Cut Trees For Kumbh
item.description: Pawar said that maintaining environmental balance is equally important along with development. His stand is in stark contrast to the insistence of the State Government on felling the trees.

item.title: Syed Ata Hasnain | Power Reset In Pak And Its Global Consequences
item.description: Recent tremors surrounding Imran Khan’s uncertain fate, constitutional experimentation through the 27th Amendment, and Asim Munir’s ascent as a potential supra-institutional authority together mark a significant internal shift. It may be Pakistan’s internal matter, yet it carries implications across law, diplomacy, counter-terrorism and regional stability

item.title: AA Edit | Rupee Plunge Offers Reality Check, Stresses Self-reliance
item.description: Analysts attribute the weakness in the rupee and domestic equities to persistent foreign investment outflows from equity markets, a widening current account deficit, and limited RBI intervention
